title: Fractions as Division
intro: Use equal sharing to explain a fraction as division.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Draw three pizzas and share them among four students. Connect each share to 3 ÷ 4 and 3/4 before trying an amount greater than one.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

Sharing 3 pizzas equally among 4 children gives each child 3 ÷ 4 = 3/4 of a pizza. Sharing 7 pizzas among 4 gives 7/4 = 1 3/4 pizzas each.

Ask your student

What does the denominator tell us about the sharing?

If your student needs help

If the student reverses the fraction, label the total and the number of recipients in the picture.
